title: SMADP Safety Profile — unverified-profile tier
description: Minimal schema for autopilot-bootstrapped profile stubs (evidence_level=unverified-profile). The full Safety Profile schema is in profile.schema.json and applies to docs-only or higher tiers. Stubs only carry the smallest set of fields needed for catalog navigation; richer fields (vendor, sandboxing, verification, etc.) are populated by the enrichment pipeline before the profile crosses into docs-only.
